The best waffle maker. My husband has wanted one like the hotels and this be is ever BETTER!

Awesome profesional product, it does make very thick waffles I have never seen waffles this thick. It's easy in use and the price/ quality is incredible. Best purchase I have made. The waffels are crispy from the outside and soft from the inside, make sure to let them cool down on a rack. And it does warm the plates evenly. This machine can be adjusted up to 300 degrees which is over kill, I don't see anyone putting it on 300 degrees. Best setting for me is 175 degrees for 2 and a half minute, it does also vary with what dough you are using.
Best waffles maker for the money. Plus, this thing is built like a tank. 200 Celsius for 3 minutes gives you perfect waffles.

A large footprint on the counter top takes up a lot of space for an occasional waffle. Unit is of typical Chinese construction, thin gauge sheet metal construction, sturdy enough for home use but questionable for commercial applications. Unit CANNOT be disassembled for cleaning, grids must be cleaned in place. Now for the good! Great waffles from the start, grids must be throughly greased to prevent sticking and that's it. I used Primier Protein mix and have not had anything but quality waffles. Better than going out! One control, temperature only and a mechanical count down timer, which you have to be mindful of. Heavy duty power cord, uses over 1400w of electricity. Heating is fairly even and cooked waffles are throughly done.
Containers are great, very similar to the name brand. I made the mistake of not realizing they didn't have lids. I bought some lids on webstaurant and thankfully they fit.
Great Cast Iron Grill. I was looking for a cast iron grill for a long time. Soo happy that a friend told me about VEVOR. Exactly what I was looking for.
The item arrived quickly and was packaged securely for its weight. The item appears to be high quality. The surface area for cooking is a bit smaller than anticipated.
Very good quality I use multiple times a week very easy to clean
Heavy, quality cast iron... used on my gas grill for smash burgers

Seems good. Made pancakes. I bought it to make smash burgers. I'll follow up when I do that. Was a little sticky after pancakes but went through this cleaning and seasoning ritual afterwards and I'll leave a follow-up.

This item is great, cast iron quality 100. The length was a lil short but I purchased the medium sized one should have brought the large so it would have extended to both burners. Wat I didn't like was the depth of it, this grill definitely need oil or some Pam spray, if using oil there is very little room on the perimeter to catch the oil and considering most meats produce oils anyways, if you don't use oil or enough oil the food STICK. Lastly, there's no handle so clean-up need to wait until the grill cools off, and I like to clean as I go so the only thing left to clean is the pot n pans I use, this wasn't a big headache, plus cleaning grills while they are hot makes for a easy clean l-up.

le ‹NAMN› est sympatique et bien conçu. pour cause de chantier de rénovation j'ai mis 2 semaines pour le déballer et quand j'ai voulu le monter j'ai constaté une coupure de 10 cm sur le coussin. je ne peux pas prouver que c'était lors de l'emballage ou si moi j'aurais entaillé le coussin en ouvrant le carton. si ça aurait été de ma faute l'emballage avec le coussin directement sous le couvercle du carton et sans protection est une erreur que vous devrier corriger. Comme il y a un doute je n'ai pas fait de réclamation. j'ai commandé un bout de cuir de la moitié du prix du ‹NAMN› pour le réparer. donc déçu.

Bought as a tv stand. Could probably modify the pullout to be cupboard doors. But really happy with price vs quality, and store blankets instead of shoes. This is a good height for the TV and is the right fit for our small space.

I bought 2 of these to create a craft closet in my standard bifold size bedroom closet. I could not be happier. Solid construction, nice appearance and easy to install. Holds standard dollar store fabric bins. I included pics as you are probably going to want one yourself.
Product arrived on time. All the pieces were there and numbered. Easy to assemble. Some issues with the wall mounting screws but had someone in the garage. Would order again
